findings.passage: While there are several routes we can take from a legislative perspective to accomplish this, an easy first step would be to require voters to show their identification each time they cast a ballot.
findings.note: Press statement issued in his name after reports of bogus voter registration applications in Lancaster and York counties. He calls for requiring voters to show identification every time they cast a ballot, and says about three of four Pennsylvanians support the idea.

findings.passage: We should all be working together to ensure Pennsylvanians can have faith in our election process.
findings.note: Same statement; frames election integrity as a shared goal and says the fraud shows why a legislative fix is needed.
